_doc: Endpoints whose generated test should skip with a reason. Smoke keys: 'METHOD /api/...' or '/api/...' (both methods). Write-negative keys are namespaced 'NOTFOUND METHOD /api/...' / 'VALIDATION METHOD /api/...' so a skipped positive never hides a negative. Every entry is a finding, not a pardon: remove it when the handler is fixed.

endpoints.NOTFOUND PUT /api/document-ingestion/ite: needs object storage, which the dev stack does not configure
endpoints.NOTFOUND PUT /api/lab/qc-results/{id}/re: the reviewer self-check runs before the lookup, so an absent run answers 400
